exams.name: Electrician licensure examination
exams.notes: Technical and practical examination; applicant must be found to possess required knowledge and skill and be versed in the laws of electricity. Class B exam based on national electrical code as it applies to farmstead or residential wiring.
exams.quote: The board shall examine an applicant for licensure and if, upon a technical and practical examination, the applicant is found to possess the required knowledge and skill and to be versed in the laws of electricity, the applicant shall be issued a license in the class for which the applicant was examined.

interval_years.quote: An electrician's license may be issued for a term of only one year, but may be renewed without examination upon the payment of the proper fee.

required.quote: An applicant for renewal of an electrician's license pursuant to section 43-09-15 must have successfully completed at least eight hours each biennium, of education relating to the standards set forth in section 43-09-21 or as otherwise prescribed by the board.

available.quote: To the extent that other states which provide for the licensing of electricians provide for similar action, the state electrical board may grant licenses of the same grade or class to electricians licensed by other states, upon payment by the applicant of the required fee, after being furnished with proof that the qualifications of the applicant are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in North Dakota.

requirements.value: Applicant must pay required fee and provide proof that their qualifications are equal to those of North Dakota licensees of the same grade or class. Reciprocity is available only to the extent the other state provides similar reciprocal action.

license_tiers.quote: The classes of electricians who may be licensed under section 43-09-09 are: 1. Master electrician. 2. Journeyman electrician. 3. Class B electrician. 4. Power limited electrician.

value: Employees of public utilities engaged in manufacture and distribution of electrical energy (terminates at first point of service attachment, except for electric meters)
Employees/contractors of telecommunication carriers or satellite/cable systems providers acting in scope of employment
Employees/contractors of household appliance dealers installing appliances to existing electrical receptacles
Representative of manufacturing firm installing/modifying controls on industrial machinery for firm's own use under direction of registered professional engineer
Individual installing a power limited system within a residential dwelling or installed with a factory connector or cord powered by an existing electrical receptacle
Coal mine installations subject to federal mine safety and health administration jurisdiction
scope_exclusions.quote: The following persons are not required to be licensed by and are not subject to regulation by the board under this chapter

qualifier_required.quote: A contract, agreement, or undertaking with another person for the installation of electrical wiring or power limited wiring or the installation of electrical or power limited system parts of other apparatus may not be entered by anyone other than a master electrician or power limited electrician.

value: General electrical contractor: must be or be associated with a master electrician

Class B electrician: may contract only for farmstead electrical wiring or residential electrical wiring in one or two family dwellings in cities with population of 2,500 or fewer
